newsitem.title: USA: Historic Hotel says SEC launched probe.
newsitem.headline: Historic Hotel says SEC launched probe.

text.p: Historic Hotel Holdings on Thursday said the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission was investigating the company for possible violations of federal securities law, including its anti-fraud provision.

Historic Hotel said in a statement that it had not yet been provided with a copy of the SEC's order of investigation. But it said the probe was intended "to determine whether or not there have been violations of the anti-fraud, securities registration and broker-dealer registration provisions of the federal securities laws."

Because of the investigation and the suspension of trading in its common stock on April 10, "there can be no assurance that the company will ever be able to make any acquisition or raise any additional capital," Historic Hotel said.
The company said that if it could not raise substantial capital it would be unable to make a previously announced rescission offer.
"The company does not now have any meaningful assets and may have significant contingent liabilities," it said.
Historic Hotel said it had about 4.4 million shares of common stock outstanding.
